prompt:
Create FOUR photoreal educational mission photos as EXACTLY TWO columns TWO rows. Overall aspect ratio8:3, ideally2560x960. Each individual photo8:3. No gutters/borders. Match source order, left warmwood and right graysciencebench. Essential evidence central90%width and upper80%height; bottom20% quiet surface. Actual physical objects and printed worksheets, no floating graphics or UI captions. Do not solve unknowns.
TOP ROW: one open cream paper worksheet containing two printed concentric-ring circular targets separated by a small cream inset. Left target has red bullseye and exactly FIVE yellow sample dots scattered widely around center (one aboveleft,oneaboveright,onefarright,onebelowleft,onebelowright). Label "SCATTER", note "check reagent / technique". Middle inset "s = ?" with "STANDARD DEVIATION" underneath, no numeric answer. Right target red bullseye with FIVE orange sample dots tightly clustered well away from center toward lower-right, label "BIAS", note "independent reference". Show clear distinction of broad scatter vs tight displaced cluster. Entire worksheet flat on desk with a pencil beside it.
BOTTOM ROW: aquarium left, clear round temporary fish-holding bucket right. Aquarium contains water,gravel,three green plants and an air tube producing bubbles but ABSOLUTELY NO FISH. Bucket contains SIX small fish waiting: threeorange,twoblue,onegreen, in clear water. Cream label "WAITING" above bucket. Between tank and bucket a small printed cream card with a dashed horizontal line and a large question mark "?", showing decision pending. Do NOT put any fish in main aquarium and do not show fish being transferred. No arrows selecting an answer or extra chemicals/equipment. Natural photographic lighting, no people, brand names or watermarks.
review: Both variants distinguish five widely scattered yellow points from five off-center clustered orange points, leave s unknown and retain different follow-up cues. Water-change photos show no fish in aquarium; all six fish remain in waiting bucket (3orange,2blue,1green), decision? unresolved.
